_comment: Mercenary traits. Schema: data/schema/traits.schema.json. PLACEHOLDERS (Phase 5 C2, Q-8): a bargaining trait per merc that the director names; until he does, these two stand in so a step-in in contract talks can be built and tested. Their ids, numbers and holders are not a design. bargain: added to the merc's step-in roll (economy.json terms). held_by: the mercs (data/mercs.json ids) who have the trait; it moves to the merc's own entry in data/mercs.json once Q-8 is answered.
